summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core requirements and thorough integration testing via `act`. Follows red/green TDD methodology with clear organization across unit tests (parsing, lookup, compliance) and integration layers. Strengths: good separation of concerns, multiple end-to-end scenarios through workflow, exact output matching for regression detection, proper test isolation and cleanup. Weaknesses: missing edge cases (empty/malformed manifests, special characters in names, version range specifiers), limited error scenario testing (no malformed JSON validation), and assumes fixture files are present and correctly structured without showing their contents. Would effectively catch regressions in main functionality but may miss unusual inputs or error paths.
